structured_output.summary: The criteria look met and tested. The diff was truncated, so I reviewed only the visible part and did not read the repository files. I found only advisory issues.

findings.text: No test passes a timezone-naive `last_modified` to `IfRange.check` when the `If-Range` date is aware. The `==` comparison would raise TypeError for that input.
No `apply_range` test sends `If-Range` with a weak response ETag, or `If-Range` with a matching date plus a mismatched ETag.

The detailed `is_resource_modified` tests, including the `If-Range` cases, were replaced by two smoke tests. This is allowed by the task, but the behaviour of the deprecated function is now barely checked.
The deprecated `make_conditional` carries a long special-case block that re-implements the malformed-Range check, plus nested `if complete_length` branches. This could be simplified.
Mutating `rv.cache_control.no_cache`/`public` after `send_file` for the deprecated `cache=False` path is a hack. The `cache=False` path could instead be built from the `send_file` arguments.

coverage.note: The parametrized cases check header precedence, methods, 304 and 412 (the 412 cases are in test_apply_conditions_precondition_failed). test_apply_conditions_304_removes_entity_headers checks that entity headers are removed.
Checks `If-None-Match: *` with exists True and False. `If-Match: *` with exists=False is checked in the precondition_failed parametrization. Accept-Ranges is asserted in test_apply_conditions.
Covers non-GET methods; test_apply_range_not_200 and test_apply_range_no_length cover non-200 and unknown or zero length. All assert the response is unchanged and Accept-Ranges is still set.
Checks clamping, the first range only, and the Content-Range values. test_apply_range_unsatisfiable and test_apply_range_ignored cover unsatisfiable ranges and non-bytes units.
Checks strong ETag matching and rejects weak and None. test_if_range_check_date checks dates. test_apply_range_ignored and test_apply_range_if_range_match cover how apply_range uses If-Range.

Checks the deprecation warning for is_byte_range_valid; test_is_resource_modified_deprecated does the same for is_resource_modified. test_make_conditional_deprecated is truncated in the diff, so I could not read it. Older make_conditional tests run under a warning filter.
Checks clamping and first-range handling. test_content_range_from_header_invalid/valid cover ContentRange validation. test_etag_set_discards_unquoted covers ETagSet.

Checks seek. test_object_detects_name_size_mtime, test_etag, test_object_without_mimetype, test_range and test_conditional_304 cover detection, the ETag, the default mimetype, ranges and conditional requests.
Checks that a conditional request gives 304 and there is no max-age by default. test_cache_deprecated and test_fallback_mimetype_deprecated check the DeprecationWarning.
Tests were added for the new methods; the tests of the deprecated functions were reduced to smoke tests, and the harness reports the suite green.
